description: This file appears to be a C source file for a Linux kernel module that implements a driver for PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) on VR9 hardware. It includes kernel headers, chip-specific headers, and defines functions for creating and removing procfs entries, handling debug commands via /proc, and managing hardware breakpoints and debug states. The file contains function implementations for testing and debugging the PTM hardware, with various controls and status readouts.

methods.name: void proc_file_create(void)
methods.description: Creates procfs entries for /driver/ifx_ptm/mem and /driver/ifx_ptm/pp32 to allow user-space interaction with PTM debugging functions.

methods.name: void proc_file_delete(void)
methods.description: Removes the procfs entries created for PTM debugging.

methods.name: int proc_write_mem(struct file * file,const char * buf,unsigned long count,void * data)
methods.description: Handles writes to the /proc file for memory reading/writing commands in debugging context.

methods.name: int proc_read_pp32(char * page,char ** start,off_t off,int count,int * eof,void * data)
methods.description: Reads debug status or state of the PTM core (or cores) for user inspection through procfs.

methods.name: int proc_write_pp32(struct file * file,const char * buf,unsigned long count,void * data)
methods.description: Controls and configures the PTM core debugging features via procfs commands, such as starting, stopping, setting breakpoints, etc.

methods.name: int stricmp(const char * p1,const char * p2)
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison; used to parse commands.

methods.name: int strincmp(const char * p1,const char * p2,int n)
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison limited to n characters.

methods.name: int get_token(char ** p1,char ** p2,int * len,int * colon)
methods.description: Parses tokens from input strings, used for command parsing.

methods.name: int get_number(char ** p,int * len,int is_hex)
methods.description: Parses numeric values from input strings, supports hex and decimal.

methods.name: void ignore_space(char ** p,int * len)
methods.description: Skips whitespace and separator characters in input strings.

methods.name: __init__ ifx_ptm_test_init
methods.description: Initializes the module, creates procfs entries.

methods.name: __exit__ ifx_ptm_test_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the module, removes procfs entries.
